Against that, a pure speed-weight change on the conserved T0 structure is the indicated, cheapest control-only intervention: because increasing the holding weight tracked a larger measured held speed in the most recent history while the source configuration sits at 0.05, I probe a single decrease to the holding weight's lower domain bound 0.025 under the fixed controller.gvs_nmpc@10.0.0, holding terminal at 0.1 and freezing all other fields. With only one development execution left, a single explicit point (method search.family_explicit@1.0.0, step null, one candidate, one backend cap) is used rather than a multi-point coordinate search; the numeric scores will guide interpretation but only the actual terminal-error, held-position and held-speed metrics with force bounds and a finite valid execution can support any claim.
